postcommit_saved_file_audit.science_summary:
Ten confirmed major provenance findings trace automatic SEEDED-to-REVIEWED promotion to the maintained graph writer and each target history. This is positive evidence of an automated promotion defect, not an assertion that no historical human review exists. EC 1.1.1.46 additionally has one confirmed minor: authored display text inherits arabinopyanose instead of arabinopyranose. Its chemical identifiers, stereochemistry, balanced reaction and verbatim source quotations must be preserved. All ten verdicts are needs_curation; no findings are provisional.

The inspected sources support the stored net reactions. Shared Rhea reactions do not establish whole-class equivalence. EC439 remains supported by coupled unstable-intermediate experiments rather than an isolated stable-substrate assay; EC440 in-plant function remains unconfirmed. EC441 has four mapped reactions and three explicitly represented, with symbolic polymer repeat balance; its correction notice concerns panel citations and does not explicitly state unchanged interpretation. EC442 conflicting abstract/Results pH directions and weak extended NADPH activity are distinguished. EC443 separates GedF from downstream GedK; EC444 supports both cofactors while its 28-percent ratio is authority-attributed. EC45 distinguishes direct human CRYL1 evidence from inferred ortholog annotations and downstream C11orf54. EC46 retains stable-product versus immediate-mechanism uncertainty and separates QuickGO EC attribution from the OLS Rhea exact association.

Source evidence is limited to the precisely declared official objects, indexed abstracts and selected primary text. Figure images, separate supplements and bibliography-only records do not supply uninspected experimental detail. Reused sources retain their original timestamps. No trait, generator, history or protein qualification was changed, and agent review supplies no human sign-off.
science_conclusions: Ten positive maintained-writer/history status findings; no universal historical-human-absence assertion.
EC46 authored arabinopyanose spelling minor preserves identifiers, alpha-L structure, valid balanced reaction and verbatim source quotations.

Coupled unstable-intermediate EC439 evidence, unconfirmed EC440 plant function, EC441 disclosed three-of-four polymer projection and correction-notice scope, EC442 conflicting pH reports and weak positive NADPH are preserved.
EC443 GedF/GedK separation, authority-attributed EC444 cofactor ratio, EC45 CRYL1/ortholog/downstream-enzyme distinction, and EC46 stable-versus-immediate lactone uncertainty remain explicit.
QuickGO EC association and separate OLS Rhea association are attributed accurately after the exact one-field correction.
